videos.description:

https://courses.errormakesclever.com/adv-fullstack?source=adv_fsd_emcvgtspodcast

Most students believe getting hired is all about learning more programming languages.
But in reality, companies look for something much deeper.

In this podcast, we discuss what startups actually expect from freshers, the biggest difference between startup and MNC hiring, why ownership matters more than certificates, and how AI is changing software development—not replacing developers.

We also explore why fundamentals are still the biggest competitive advantage, how students should use AI correctly, and what separates candidates who get hired from those who don’t.
Whether you’re a college student, fresher, software developer, or someone preparing for placements, this conversation will help you understand how the industry really works.

In this podcast, you’ll learn:
 • How startups hire freshers
 • Startup vs MNC hiring differences
 • Why problem-solving matters more than syntax
 • How AI is changing software engineering
 • Why fundamentals still beat AI prompting
 • Common mistakes students make during 

placements
 • Ownership mindset vs college mindset
 • How to prepare for software development 

careers
 • The future of AI jobs and developer roles
 • Practical advice for engineering students
